intro:
Read the case. Search the scene.
Find the hidden clue that reveals the truth.
A quick mystery challenge for sharp eyes.
description:
Investigate illustrated mystery scenes and spot the hidden clue that helps explain each case.

Read the short case prompt, examine the scene carefully, then choose the suspicious place or item. The rules are simple, so you can start solving right away.

How to play:
・Read the case
・Look closely at the illustration
・Select the clue you think is important
・Use a hint if you get stuck

With 30 stages to solve, each case is short enough for a quick break while still testing your observation, logic, and intuition.

Play solo at your own pace, or discuss each scene with family and friends to see who notices the key detail first.

Recommended for players who enjoy mystery puzzles, detective-style brain teasers, visual riddles, hidden clues, and quick thinking challenges.

Can you catch the detail everyone else missed?
